subject.title: Stability, installer auth, runtime compatibility, and context-management improvements

question: Should maintainers split this broad field report into focused owner-owned issues while keeping it open as an umbrella, or should one owner drive a single coordinated design for dashboard auth persistence, Codex/OpenAI auth setup, runtime atomicity, final-turn liveness, and context hygiene?
rationale: The remaining work crosses product UX, security boundaries, native installer/app behavior, provider auth contracts, runtime/package compatibility, and session-state policy, which automation cannot safely choose as one implementation direction.

options.title: Split and keep umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open as the parent, link the existing dashboard-auth issue, and create or designate focused owner items for the remaining auth, runtime/update, final-turn, and context-hygiene subproblems.

options.title: Single owner design
options.body: Assign one maintainer to write a coordinated design before implementation, accepting slower progress in exchange for one integrated reliability plan.

options.title: Close after narrower links
options.body: Close this only after every remaining subproblem has a canonical issue or merged fix linked from the close rationale.

recommendation.title: Split and keep umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the parent, link the existing dashboard-auth issue, and create or designate focused owner items for the remaining auth, runtime/update, final-turn, and context-hygiene subproblems.

likelyOwner.reason: The open questions combine agents, security, telemetry, and auth/provider behavior, which are areas listed for this owner and reflected in recent related commits.
